name: Daksh Instruments Pvt Ltd
india_angle: Daksh Instruments Pvt Ltd is based in Indore, India, and has been participating in national and international exhibitions, indicating a strong local presence.
summary: Daksh Instruments Pvt Ltd specializes in the manufacturing and export of testing and quality checking instruments, including non-contact measuring and ultrasonic equipment. Their products are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in quality assurance and measurement processes.
